data.title: AI-Generated Phishing Content Stylometric Detection
data.description: Detects AI-generated phishing content using stylometric features. Research shows XGBoost with 60 stylometric features detects GPT-4o-generated phishing with 96% accuracy and 99% AUC. Key features: imperative verb count, clause density, first-person pronoun usage, urgency markers, authority indicators, sentiment manipulation, financial trigger words, and semantic inconsistency. DetectGPT achieves ~0.95 AUROC via zero-shot statistical signatures. This rule defines the feature extraction pipeline and scoring thresholds for deployment in email security and fraud communication analysis systems.

detection.condition: stylometric_score > 0.75 (composite of 60 features) AND (urgency_marker_count > 3 OR authority_indicator_count > 2) AND imperative_verb_ratio > 0.15

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for AI-Generated Phishing Content Stylometric Detection
// NLP model scoring is performed externally; this query filters scored results
// Assumes stylometric features are pre-computed and ingested as enriched email events
#repo="email_security" #event_type="content_analysis"
content_type="email"
| stylometric_score > 0.75
| (urgency_marker_count > 3 OR authority_indicator_count > 2)
| imperative_verb_ratio > 0.15
| select([@timestamp, sender, recipient, subject, stylometric_score,
          imperative_verb_ratio, urgency_marker_count, authority_indicator_count,
          financial_trigger_word_count, semantic_inconsistency_score])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
queries.python:
# Python pseudocode for stylometric feature extraction pipeline
# Deploy via Splunk DSDL or standalone NLP service

import spacy
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
import xgboost as xgb

URGENCY_MARKERS = ['immediately', 'urgent', 'act now', 'deadline',
                   'expires', 'limited time', 'final notice', 'asap']
AUTHORITY_INDICATORS = ['official', 'authorized', 'compliance',
                       'government', 'legal', 'regulatory', 'mandatory']
FINANCIAL_TRIGGERS = ['payment', 'transfer', 'invoice', 'account',
                     'balance', 'wire', 'refund', 'settlement']

def extract_stylometric_features(text):
    doc = nlp(text)
    features = {
        'imperative_verb_ratio': count_imperative_verbs(doc) / len(doc),
        'clause_density': count_clauses(doc) / count_sentences(doc),
        'first_person_ratio': count_first_person(doc) / len(doc),
        'urgency_count': sum(1 for m in URGENCY_MARKERS if m in text.lower()),
        'authority_count': sum(1 for m in AUTHORITY_INDICATORS if m in text.lower()),
        'financial_trigger_count': sum(1 for t in FINANCIAL_TRIGGERS if t in text.lower()),
        'sentence_length_variance': np.var([len(s) for s in doc.sents]),
        'vocabulary_diversity': len(set(t.lemma_ for t in doc)) / len(doc),
        # ... 52 additional features
    }
    return features
